description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a dedicated nursing leader to oversee all nursing operations, ensure the highest standards of patient care, and contribute to a positive and supportive environment for both residents and staff. We offer a competitive annual salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000.

The ideal candidate will be a compassionate and strategic leader with a proven track record in long-term care. You will be responsible for managing nursing staff, implementing clinical policies and procedures, ensuring regulatory compliance, and fostering a culture of excellence. Join a team committed to providing outstanding care and making a meaningful difference in the lives of our residents.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as a Director of Nursing or in a similar nursing leadership role within a skilled nursing facility.
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations pertaining to long-term care.
Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and manage a diverse nursing team.
Excellent clinical assessment, critical thinking, and communication skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive annual salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000.
